jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced **Senior Full Stack Software Engineer** to join our dynamic and growing team. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in designing, building, and maintaining scalable web applications and APIs, leveraging cloud-native technologies. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of software development, from conception to deployment, including designing system architecture, implementing solutions, and optimizing performance.

Deep cloud engineering expertise is essential for this role, including hands-on experience architecting, developing, deploying, and operating production-grade cloud-native applications. Candidates with substantial Azure/AWS experience demonstrating a level of technical depth and responsibility commensurate with the requirements outlined below will be considered.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **API Development**: Design, develop, and maintain robust, secure, and scalable RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot, integrating with Azure services and external platforms through Azure API Management.
* F**ull Stack Development**: Build responsive, high-performance front-end and back-end applications using modern frameworks and technologies (Java, Spring Boot, React, Node.js, etc.), leveraging Azure cloud services.
* **Automated Test Development**: Develop automated API and microservices tests, including contract testing and service virtualization, as well as UI tests using modern automation tools and frameworks.
* **Cloud-Native Architecture:** Design and implement scalable, cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, leveraging Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), following best practices for security, reliability, scalability, and performance.
* **Containerization**: Build, deploy, and manage containerized applications using Docker, Azure Container Registry (ACR), Azure Container Apps, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), including container orchestratio

jobs.title: AI Agent and Workflow Developer
jobs.description:
**Overview**

As an AI Agent and Workflow Developer, you’ll build and improve software that helps teams automate work and connect systems. You’ll contribute across application and web development, from designing APIs to delivering reliable, scalable solutions. Your impact: By creating dependable workflows and integrations, you help users complete tasks more efficiently and access consistent information.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop AI agent workflows and applications using suitable programming languages and software engineering practices.
* Design and integrate REST (Representational State Transfer) and RESTful APIs, applying system design, design patterns, and microservices where appropriate.
* Build front-end features with JavaScript and JavaScript frameworks, including React and Express, and support web development needs.
* Maintain cloud infrastructure and IT infrastructure, with attention to scalability, access controls such as role-based access control (RBAC), and reliable operations.
* Collaborate through Agile software development, version control, and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD); test, document, and refine software designs.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in software development, application development, software design, or software engineering; familiarity with scalable systems and APIs.
* Working knowledge of SQL and MySQL, Linux, and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Experience with Git, GitHub, or SVN; familiarity with Agile practices and CI/CD.
* Relevant languages and frameworks may include Python, Ruby on Rails, Java, C#,.NET, C, C++, VBA, JavaScript, React, and Express. The role’s needs determine which are essential; experience across every listed technology is not required.
* Quantum engineering experience is a nice-to-have; practical system development and integration skills are valuable.

Pay: $15.00 - $35.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote
